sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.zh: 但它们都太棒了。

sentences.en: You know, the editors and Greg, I never regretted anything that was taken out of the show.
sentences.zh: 你知道，剪辑师和格雷格，我从不后悔任何被删减的片段。

sentences.en: I, like, had complete confidence that, because you know how some people get possessed of, like, well, why did that scene go?
sentences.zh: 我完全信任他们，因为你知道有些人会纠结，比如，为什么那场戏被删了？

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: What happened there?
sentences.zh: 那里发生了什么？

sentences.en: They were so good about structuring the show and what needed to be in and what might have been really funny but didn't help.
sentences.zh: 他们非常擅长把控剧集的结构，知道什么必须保留，什么虽然很好笑但对剧情没帮助。

sentences.en: Or might have explained a whole backstory.
sentences.zh: 或者有些片段可能会解释整个背景故事。

sentences.zh: 但他们只是让观众直接进入剧情。

sentences.en: They didn't have to, like, explain everything.
sentences.zh: 他们不需要解释一切。

sentences.en: But every once in a while as we're doing this rewatch and we find a deleted scene or something that's such a nugget,
sentences.zh: 但偶尔当我们重温剧集，发现这样一个删减片段或像金子一样的素材时，

sentences.en: we're like, oh, that's why he would come in these costumes and give a big presentation.

sentences.zh: 都是因为“呼呼”猫头鹰。

sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.zh: 猫头鹰“呼呼”。

sentences.en: Did you get to give notes on things?
sentences.zh: 你有机会对这些内容提出意见吗？

sentences.en: Like, were you very much a part of that?
sentences.zh: 那你当时参与度很高吗？

sentences.en: Like, I would remember sometimes you would stay behind after a table read and they would want to know your thoughts and things.
sentences.zh: 比如，我记得有时剧本围读结束后，你会留下来，他们想听听你的想法之类的。

sentences.en: They were really collaborative and open in that way, right?
sentences.zh: 他们在这方面真的很乐于合作，也很开放，对吧？

sentences.en: For sure.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the fact that so many of the writers were also actors on the show, there was such a great connection that it didn't feel like different facets of the show.
sentences.zh: 而且因为很多编剧本身也是剧中的演员，大家联系非常紧密，所以不会觉得剧组分成了不同的派系。

sentences.en: Again, everybody just felt like they were all collaborators.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，每个人都觉得自己是合作者。

sentences.en: And the writers were part of the ensemble, which I think helped because they understood everyone's voice that much better because they were there and they were hearing it.
sentences.zh: 编剧也是剧组的一员，我觉得这很有帮助，因为他们就在现场，能亲耳听到大家的表演，所以对每个人的角色语调把握得更好。

sentences.en: But yeah, I mean, I'd weigh in.
sentences.zh: 不过确实，我是会发表意见。

sentences.en: Would you pitch ideas?
sentences.zh: 你会提点子吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 会。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Do you remember any?
sentences.zh: 还记得什么具体的点子吗？

sentences.en: Well, I remember one specifically, and this was later on.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我记得一个特别的，那是后期发生的事了。

sentences.en: This was when you and Jim were getting married and they wanted to have a horse go over Niagara Falls.
sentences.zh: 当时是你和吉姆要结婚了，他们想安排一匹马从尼亚加拉大瀑布上冲下去。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 我当时举手说，我们不能这么做。

sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.zh: 不只是你一个人反对。

sentences.zh: 哦，显然，当我们拆解那一集剧本时，我们和格雷格聊过，他说史蒂夫也劝我别拍。

sentences.zh: 你也劝我别拍。

sentences.zh: 真的，每个人都劝过他。

sentences.zh: 他当时很难放弃那个念头。

sentences.en: Well, I'm sure if it was Greg, it would have been funny.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我相信如果是格雷格来拍，效果应该会很有趣。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对会。

sentences.en: But, and those were rare moments when you felt like, no, I, yeah, I mean, little notes here and there.
sentences.zh: 不过，那种你需要站出来说“不”的时刻很少，我确实会提一些零星的小建议。

sentences.en: But, again, those writers were so good and so on point about everything that it was more in addition to as opposed to negating.
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，那些编剧太优秀了，对一切都把握得非常到位，所以我的建议更多是锦上添花，而不是否定他们的想法。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Side note, did you know, we didn't know this, Randy shared this with us, that up until, like, right, like, the day before, they had a horse.
sentences.zh: 顺便提一下，你知道吗？我们之前都不知道，是兰迪后来告诉我们的，直到拍摄前一天，他们真的找来了一匹马。

sentences.en: They were training in a big water pool at Paramount Studios.
sentences.zh: 他们当时在派拉蒙影业的一个大水池里训练那匹马。

sentences.en: Like, it was, they were all systems go, like, right up until, like, the day before.
sentences.zh: 就是说，一切都准备就绪了，直到拍摄前一天还是这样。

sentences.en: See, that's.
sentences.zh: 你看，这就是……

sentences.zh: 真的有一匹马在接受训练。

sentences.en: Of course there was.
sentences.zh: 当然会有。

sentences.en: That's what, you don't realize when you write something, somebody starts to build it.
sentences.zh: 这就是你写剧本时意识不到的问题，一旦写出来，就有人开始着手去造了。

sentences.zh: 所以当你写下“哦，现在我们要去树林里拍戏了”。

sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 然后一个月后，你就得开车一个半小时去洛杉矶的森林里拍几个镜头。

sentences.zh: 当时就会想：我为什么要写这个？

sentences.zh: 真是个糟糕的主意。

sentences.en: Freezing.
sentences.zh: 冷得要命。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Terrible.
sentences.zh: 太糟糕了。

sentences.zh: 他掉进了一条小溪里。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.zh: 我为什么要写这个？

sentences.en: So, we've talked how the show was slow to find an audience.
sentences.zh: 我们之前聊过这部剧起初观众寥寥。

sentences.en: It was sort of like we were doing a little theater production and no one's seeing it.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像我们在演一场小型舞台剧，却没人来看。

sentences.en: But then one day it turned a corner and everybody knew the show.
sentences.zh: 但后来有一天，情况出现了转机，大家都知道了这部剧。

sentences.en: And we had people coming up to us.
sentences.zh: 开始有人主动来找我们搭话了。

sentences.en: Jenna, do you remember we were at an awards show and Laura Dern was like, stop, I have to talk to you.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，你还记得吗？我们在颁奖典礼上，劳拉·邓恩走过来对我们说，等等，我必须跟你们聊聊。

sentences.en: And we're like, what?
sentences.zh: 我们当时心想，什么事？

sentences.en: She was like, I love your show.
sentences.zh: 她说，我太喜欢你们的剧了。

sentences.en: And I was like, this is Laura Dern.
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，这可是劳拉·邓恩啊。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: But was there anyone like that for you, Steve, that sort of surprised you and caught you off guard that was a fan of the show?
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫，对你来说有没有这样的人，让你感到惊讶或措手不及，而且还是这部剧的粉丝？

sentences.en: Laura Dern.
sentences.zh: 劳拉·邓恩。

sentences.en: Same thing.
sentences.zh: 也是一样的情况。

sentences.en: I met her somewhere down the road.
sentences.zh: 后来我在别的地方遇见了她。

sentences.en: I was doing a promotional thing with her.
sentences.zh: 当时我和她一起做宣传活动。

sentences.en: And I wasn't even aware of your encounter with her.
sentences.zh: 我甚至都不知道你之前和她有过那次接触。

sentences.en: Because she was clearly a fan because she was very excited to talk about the show.
sentences.zh: 因为她显然是粉丝，她聊起这部剧时非常兴奋。

sentences.en: And, you know, she said the same thing to me.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，她也对我说了同样的话。

sentences.en: She loved it.
sentences.zh: 她很喜欢这部剧。

sentences.en: And it's nice when anyone likes something that you're a part of.
sentences.zh: 当有人喜欢你参与的作品时，感觉总是很棒。

sentences.en: And especially nice when somebody that you respect like that and has sort of a critical eye for things likes your show.
sentences.zh: 尤其是当你尊敬的人，而且那种眼光独到的人也喜欢你的剧时，感觉就更好了。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it was really nice.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，真的很棒。

sentences.en: It was nice hearing any of it, you know.
sentences.zh: 听到这些评价都很开心，你知道的。

sentences.en: Because you're right.
sentences.zh: 因为你说得对。

sentences.en: Early on, it felt like we were in a vacuum.
sentences.zh: 早期的时候，感觉我们就像是在真空里一样。

sentences.en: And is any, let alone appreciating, is anyone watching it?
sentences.zh: 根本不知道有没有人在看，更别提欣赏了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Is anyone, you know, paying any sort of attention?
sentences.zh: 不知道有没有人在关注。

sentences.en: And the only part of it that mattered to me was the continuation of the show.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，唯一重要的事情就是这部剧能继续拍下去。

sentences.en: So, I wanted to have enough people watch it so they kept letting us do it.
sentences.zh: 所以我只希望有足够多的人看，这样他们才会让我们继续做下去。

sentences.en: Because I didn't really care about the acclaim.
sentences.zh: 因为我其实并不在乎那些赞誉。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: Or, like, we knew that we liked it and we were having fun with it.
sentences.zh: 或者说，我们知道自己喜欢这部剧，而且拍得很开心。

sentences.en: And I think we all felt like it was special in that moment.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们当时都觉得这部剧很特别。

sentences.en: And that's what mattered to me.
sentences.zh: 那才是我真正在乎的。

sentences.en: But, yeah.
sentences.zh: 不过，确实。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: It was Laura Dern.
sentences.zh: 就是劳拉·邓恩。

sentences.en: I remember that time early on because we, a few of us had gotten on MySpace.
sentences.zh: 我记得早期那段时间，因为我们当中有几个人注册了MySpace。

sentences.en: And we were able to interact with the, like, 17 people who were watching our show in the beginning.
sentences.zh: 我们得以和那最初看剧的17个人互动。

sentences.en: And they were such fans.
sentences.zh: 他们真的是铁杆粉丝。

sentences.en: And they so got it.
sentences.zh: 他们完全看懂了。

sentences.en: And they so appreciated it.
sentences.zh: 他们非常欣赏这部剧。

sentences.en: And that really, like, kind of, that just felt so good, you know.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉真的特别好，你知道吗。

sentences.en: Because when you make a television show, you don't hear the people laugh when they watch it.
sentences.zh: 因为当你制作一部电视剧时，你听不到观众看剧时的笑声。

sentences.en: And you don't know how it's being received or a movie or whatever, I guess, unless you sneak in the theater.
sentences.zh: 你不知道观众的反响如何，电影或其他作品也一样，除非你偷偷溜进电影院。

sentences.en: But you can't, like, go sneak in people's living rooms while they watch it.
sentences.zh: 但你总不能溜进别人家里看他们看剧吧。

sentences.en: So, I always loved when someone told us that they loved it, especially a fellow artiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直很喜欢有人告诉我们他们很喜欢这部剧，尤其是同行艺术家。

sentences.en: And they were excited, too, because the show was different with the documentary style and the looking at the camera.
sentences.zh: 他们也很兴奋，因为这部剧的纪录片风格和直视镜头的拍摄手法与众不同。

sentences.zh: 你们在得到《办公室》的角色后，会忍不住看向镜头吗？

sentences.zh: 我还没接过哪份工作是完全不需要看向镜头的。

sentences.en: Same.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: I can't not make the camera a character now.
sentences.zh: 我现在已经没法不把镜头当成一个角色了。

sentences.en: It's so, such a habit.
sentences.zh: 这已经成了一种习惯。

sentences.en: At least once.
sentences.zh: 至少会有一次。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I'm sure on Foxcatcher, I, like, looked into the camera and went, nope, you cannot comment on what you just did.

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 因为那不是这部剧的风格。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Same for me.
sentences.zh: 我也是一样。

sentences.en: I actually had a director say, Angela, you just looked right down the barrel.
sentences.zh: 其实有位导演曾对我说：安吉拉，你刚才直勾勾地盯着镜头看了。

sentences.en: I was like, oh, I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 我就说：哦，抱歉。

sentences.en: I looked to the left or right.
sentences.zh: 我当时看向了左边或右边。

sentences.en: It was such a fun kind of discipline.
sentences.zh: 这真是一种有趣的训练。

sentences.en: Know who was really good at that right off the bat was Amy AdaMs.
sentences.zh: 你知道谁一开始就特别擅长这个吗？艾米·亚当斯。

sentences.en: I'll never forget because it was kind of a learned strength, I think, on the show to figure out the right way to play the camera,
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记，因为我觉得在剧中掌握如何正确地与镜头互动是一种习得的能力，

sentences.en: to invite the camera in and to make it feel like these people aren't used to the cameras.
sentences.zh: 要学会邀请镜头进入场景，并让观众觉得这些人并不习惯被拍摄。

sentences.en: So, you couldn't be too savvy, especially at firSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，你不能表现得太精明，尤其是在刚开始的时候。

sentences.en: You couldn't play it too well.
sentences.zh: 你不能演得太老练。

sentences.en: You needed to have an awareness of it without, like, having an over-awareness of it.
sentences.zh: 你需要对镜头有意识，但又不能表现得太刻意。

sentences.en: Yes.

sentences.zh: 卖手提包，没错。

sentences.en: And I remember she just had, like, this – she was right up to speed with everybody else in terms of how to play the camera.
sentences.zh: 我记得她当时就——她在如何与镜头互动方面，很快就跟上了大家的节奏。

sentences.en: Like, it's eavesdropping.

sentences.zh: 我不知道该如何对此做出反应。

sentences.zh: 那种我们已经学会如何表现的内在不适感。

sentences.zh: 所以，她在这方面真的很棒。

sentences.zh: 那真是一次有趣的经历——我们以后再也不会有机会做这样的事了。

sentences.en: It was a really interesting acting exercise to be, you know, you're doing – you're in your character, and your character is also being watched.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常有趣的表演练习，你知道，你既要扮演你的角色，而你的角色同时又在被监视。

sentences.en: So, there was, like, another layer of something going on with all of these characters, which is kind of cool.
sentences.zh: 所以，所有这些角色身上都多了一层东西，这真的很酷。

sentences.zh: 在与你的化学反应方面，我最喜欢的客串明星之一是蒂姆·梅多斯。

sentences.zh: 因为简不再是简·莱文森·古尔德了。
